snippet.title: Metro 2039 - PlayStation 5 Pro Gameplay Reveal | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Your first look at METRO 2039 console gameplay captured in Performance Mode on PS5 PRO at 60FPS with Ray Tracing enabled.
 
Join the mysterious Stranger as he journeys into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.
 
Experience the most shocking METRO adventure yet in a powerful single-player story that weaves exploration, survival, combat and stealth across a hauntingly beautiful but deadly world with unparalleled immersion. 
 
Inspired by the worldwide best-selling METRO book trilogy by Dmitry Glukhovsky.

#ps5 #ps5games #ps5pro #stateofplay #metro2039 

Rated Mature
